svg.title: Less calldata, more gas in every recorded pair.
svg.text: PAIRED TRANSACTIONS - SAME PROOF AND PUBLIC INPUTS
150 paired increases under the recorded Shanghai configuration.
Gas units; paired percentages are computed per proof.
Compression evaluated by a read-only local call.
Execution difference includes both entry points; it is not isolated decompression opcode cost.
Medians are statistics; individual transactions use integer gas. No mainnet fees or full-payment cost is inferred.
